description: In every \(M\models\mathrm{PA}\), a formula with any fixed finite tuple of parameters holds everywhere if it holds at zero and is preserved by successor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA_induction.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {k : ℕ} (φ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit)) (a : Fin k → M)
  (hzero : φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M))
  (hstep :
    ∀ (b : M),
      φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b) →
        φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b))
  (b : M) : φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b)
